description: A shape to copy for something the distribution already packages: install the package, drop a systemd override beside its unit, start it. Nothing is downloaded, so nothing needs a hash - apt has already checked its own signatures.

fields.label: Package name
fields.help: Exactly as apt knows it. This is passed as one argument, so it cannot smuggle a second package or a flag.

fields.label: Unit the package installs
fields.help: Informational only - the unit this template manages is fixed as generic-apt.service, because a template cannot decide at install time which unit it is allowed to touch.

fields.label: Environment line
fields.help: One KEY=value written into the override.

install.content:
[Unit]
Description=Generic apt-packaged service
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
Environment={{extra_environment}}
ExecStart=/usr/bin/env sleep infinity
Restart=always
RestartSec=10
DynamicUser=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
